scoring: Use the revised frozen method for the first run on this new article and keep matches to the earlier model as a secondary comparison. The complete 2024 vote occupies four source blocks, so it cannot achieve full direct top-three credit. Preserve that failure and report number of distinct mandatory direct blocks retrieved as a secondary diagnostic. For the 2011 claim combine an exhaustive calendar-year register of UN Security Council vetoes with the historical admissions record. The necessary vote-list rows and the application date distinguish a possible veto threat from the actual use of a veto on this application. Speaker attribution and speech content must both be directly retrievable when they occur on different pages.

vote-2024.note: The complete 2024 vote lists South Korea, names the US voter against and both abstaining states, and gives the 12–1–2 count and non-adoption. UN S/PV.9609 p.3.

us-rationale.note: The US representative explains the vote in terms of direct talks, then names the two parties explicitly. UN S/PV.9609 p.4.

palestinian-quote.note: Mansour takes the floor on p.10. He asks the Council the annexation and impunity questions on p.12, still in the same intervention. Attribution only, not a judgment on the events in his questions.

israeli-thanks.note: Erdan of Israel explicitly thanks the United States and especially President Biden. UN S/PV.9609 p.13.

vote-2011.note: The application came before the Council in September. In the UN Library's complete calendar-year list the only US veto was in February; October concerned Syria and was vetoed by China and Russia. No 2011 US veto on this application. S/2011/705 para 21 also reports the committee's lack of consensus.

public-opinion.note: Statements about political support at the meeting do not supply a comparable US opinion poll or establish a worsening trend.
